props.name: colorPalette
props.description: Color palette applied to the button. Controls the background, text, and border colors for all visual variants. Default: `'primary'`

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the button, controlling height, padding, and typography. Default: `'md'`

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button. Default: `'fill'`

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
Accepts a ReactElement or a function that returns the element to render.
